{{Quote|Guards, let us into this warehouse.''"<br />"''We're under strict orders not to let anyone in.|This guard and the police captain|<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>}}
This '''Mandalorian''', along with another corrupt officer, was guarding a warehouse on the [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|shipping docks]] which was used by [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to mix [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]] and [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|beverage tea]].

==Biography==
When [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Unidentified Mandalorian police captain (Sundari)|police captain]] came to investigate the compound, this guard and the other one barred them entering. When the police captain and Satine insisted that they open the door, this guard pulled out his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and attempted to strike Satine, but the captain quickly overpowered him and the other guard. He was later arrested when Satine and the others discovered the plot.
